items.html: Now, the vapours that were fitting for these seven kings came out through the nails of the feet. And even though the nails are ten, while the Nekudot that were broken are only the seven lower ones, the matter is that there are also two kinds of posterior of AVI that were broken; thus they are nine discernments. And the tenth is that in the Keter too there was some blemish, as will be written below, with God’s help; and that is the discernment of its NHY, which entered and were in the secret of Mochin for AVI, and they too were broken. Thus they are ten discernments, corresponding to the ten vapours that came out from the nails of his feet. And the whole discernment of the emergence of these ten vapours through his nails was entirely because of their lack of reception from the light of the upper Ozen, as above; and therefore this cause brought about all of this, and the annulment of the kings.
